bridgeRouteRisk.summary: All five authored TBILL deployments are reviewed as independent native-issuance routes: Ethereum, Arbitrum (zero supply), and BNB Chain (18 decimals) OpenEden UUPS vaults, the Solana Token-2022 mint (zero supply), and the XRPL TBL issuer. No public bridge contract, representation token, lockbox, adapter, relay, validator/DVN, rate limit, or burn-before-mint route was identified in the reviewed primary sources, so no bridge controls are authored. Whether OpenEden operates an off-chain issuer-native burn/mint service remains unresolved and is not asserted by this profile.
